'''''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''''' was a guidebook published by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be used as an instruction manual for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] as they familiarized themselves with the Order's teachings and the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

First published in the decade following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], the idea for a manual was proposed by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Fae Coven]]; who, with the help of her fellow [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], was able to complete the book and circulate it amongst the Order's [[Jedi academy|academy]] students. While Coven was the primary [[Author/Legends|author]], several other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] contributed to the book, adding details that related to their specializations as Jedi. These Masters included [[Morrit Ch'gally/Legends|Morrit Ch'gally]], [[Bowspritz]], [[Sabla-Mandibu]], [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]], [[Crix Sunburris]], [[Skarch Vaunk]], and [[Gal-Stod Slagistrough]].

As of [[115 BBY]], the book had been published in its third edition, seeing slight revision, and factual correction. Over the next one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]], one copy of the book was passed down from Jedi Master to [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], starting with Grand Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who passed it along to [[Thame Cerulian]], [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. This particular copy, well annotated by its various owners and filled with memorabilia from over the years, survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and fell into the possession of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who likewise added his own commentary. After the Emperor's [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|death]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the book was recovered by [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] near the remains of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], and given to Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Skywalker used this material, as well as several [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] he had gathered over the years, to rebuild the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] after its destruction by Sidious.
